title: List metadata (.list.yml)
description: YAML body of the .list.yml file inside a per-list folder. Mirror of SPEC.md §7 .list.yml example.

id.description: ULID. Folder name MUST match this id. The Inbox sentinel id is 00000000000000000000INBOX0.

name.description: Human-readable list name. May contain any UTF-8.

kind.description: List type. Determines canonical view + which fields are shown in the editor.

color.description: Named accent colour from the SPEC palette.

icon.description: SF Symbol name on iOS; mapped to platform-equivalent on Android (Material), Linux (symbolic), Windows (Fluent).

position.description: Fractional index for manual ordering of lists in the sidebar.
